source_basis.interpretation: Historical loading evidence only; no v2 mission, trajectory, model, or policy result is established.

scenario.strike_semantics: abstract selection/assignment only; no weapon control, projectile, ballistics, or physical damage simulation

decision_class.forced_definition: safety-critical decision that must bypass the learned gate
decision_class.ordinary_definition: normal decision subject to the learned gate

separate_fields.event_cause: record independently; do not encode as decision_class

outcome_labels.unknown_or_empty_handling: exclude from supervised label counts and report separately

stages.name: pilot_signal_and_workload
stages.selection_rule: assess decision signal and feasible/nontrivial workload; do not choose winners or favorable scenarios

stages.name: trajectory_generation
stages.minimum_counting_unit: unique state_id after deduplication; represent coverage across seven task classes and scenario groups
stages.cap_action_if_threshold_unmet: stop learned-model comparison as unavailable; do not exceed 168 trajectories or move validation data into training

stages.name: fit_and_evaluate

world_model_semantics.G: graph PPO policy with ordinary critic
world_model_semantics.GWM: graph PPO policy with frozen WM and auxiliary critic; not a gate condition
world_model_semantics.wm_training: train separately on paired suffix gain labels using declared supervised loss, then freeze before policy evaluation
world_model_semantics.auxiliary_gradient: WM outputs are stop-gradient inputs; auxiliary loss updates auxiliary critic, not actor directly or frozen WM; trigger rule is unchanged
world_model_semantics.gate_independence: ET, light, WM-gate, and 4-minute are trigger/gate conditions orthogonal to G versus GWM critic choice
world_model_semantics.inference: frozen WM output is available to the auxiliary critic; any gate behavior is determined only by the assigned condition

stages.post_freeze_recollection: recollect/resample only relevant reconstructor train/validation gain labels using fixed split membership
stages.test_sealing: do not construct or resample test labels; unseal only after methods and checkpoints are frozen

measurement.simulator_application_stepping_wall_cloc: measure separately as experiment infrastructure/runtime cost; exclude from online decision latency and task/mission cost
measurement.task_mission_cost: report separately; include consequences of delayed command effectiveness
